zh-CN.title: 桌面录音反馈更灵敏
items: 录音波形改为更精简的左右对称布局，轻声反馈更明显且峰值更克制
足迹浮层继续向右调整，避免左侧内容贴近聊天框边界

en.title: More responsive desktop voice feedback
items: Voice waves are now compact and mirrored, with clearer low-volume feedback and calmer peaks
The footprint popover now sits farther right to keep content clear of the conversation edge
